_comment: Baseline scores per (department, metric). Regenerated by the nightly Tier-4 continuous-eval job. The PR gate compares against this file — any regression > 0.05 on any metric within any department fails the build. Departments not yet observed are absent from `aggregates`; they get their baseline written on the first successful run against a live deployment. NOTE (insurance golden set): every department is intentionally left empty. No reviewer-approved measured run of data/golden/dataset.jsonl (orchestrator) or data/golden/harness.jsonl (copilot-sdk) exists yet, so the gates report `regression_status=unavailable` instead of passing. Before aggregates can be established: the Foundry SDK evaluators (azure-ai-evaluation 1.1.0) still send `max_tokens`, which gpt-5.x deployments reject, and FOUNDRY_JUDGE_DEPLOYMENT must name a compatible judge so the triage and safety rubrics can run. A reviewer must approve the first measured numbers.
